name: Legacy Console Graphics
description: Recreates the lighting, fog and colour characteristics of Minecraft's classic console editions.

settings.name: Fog Start
settings.description: Distance where terrain starts fading, as a percentage of render distance. Kept below Fog End automatically.

settings.name: Fog End
settings.description: Distance where terrain disappears into the atmosphere. Capped inside the loaded terrain to hide its edge.

settings.name: Console Gamma
settings.description: Lifts the rendered world's midtones, including sunlit block textures. Keeps black unchanged and leaves menus and the HUD alone.

settings.name: Daylight Warmth
settings.description: Subtle warm daylight and atmospheric colours. Fades at night and during bad weather.

settings.name: Contrast
settings.description: Contrast of the rendered world: darkens shadow colours and brightens highlights. Original block-face shading stays intact.

settings.name: Water Visibility
settings.description: Underwater viewing distance. Water stays blue and foggy; lava keeps its original dense fog.
